notes: Final Gate 1 plan, synthesized from candidate B (50 cm grid, straight spine, axis-centred money shot), candidate C (Demon #1 staged as a corridor fight at the passage junction, prop-free axis strip, explicit prop footprints) and candidate A (drawing-proportion reads: near-square break room with counter east / fridge SE / table centred, women's room as a band under the corridor running east to the break-room wall line, restroom doors facing, vanity arrow landing in the men's room, sketch X positions kept as notes). Plan space per Docs/FLOORPLAN-SCHEMA.md: x right on the photo, y down toward the window; rects are interior clear dimensions; shared walls are exactly 20 cm. Grid rule: every room origin on the 50 cm grid, every interior dimension 50k-20 (280, 430, 480, 580, 780, 930, 980, 1080, 1480), every coordinate on 10. Design axis x = 1240 = centreline of corridor_south, of the reception->CEO door and of the window; the axis strip x 1100-1380 stays prop-free from the corridor junction (y 1450) to the glass (y 4580), the only Gate 1 object in it being the passage's reference figure against the passage's west wall (x 1105-1155, west of the 120 cm door slot). corridor_main is one straight 280 spine (x 500-1980) continued west by corridor_blocked (collapse 200 deep at its far end); elevator_lobby is an open 480 x 480 alcove north of the junction (shut doors 200 x 220 on its north wall); the men's and women's doors face each other across the spine at x 1740; the 980 x 780 break room closes the east end. corridor_south (280 x 930) drops from the junction to reception between office_2 (west; its door is on the CORRIDOR, 4 m west of the junction) and the women's band + office_1 (east). Demon #1: emerges from office_2's door on the dead-end side while the player stands at the junction; retreat EAST toward the break room (760 clear), dodge north into the alcove or south into the passage. Demon #2: lurks in the NE lounge pocket of the CEO office behind a 430 cm full-height screen wall 300 cm inside the door wall, hidden from both jambs and the door centre with >= 75 cm margin (proof in Docs/FLOORPLAN.md) and from the whole axis strip until y 3670; the trigger is the full-width strip y 3650-3750 (150-250 cm inside the door wall), which fires before the capsule clears the wall's free end from anywhere in the strip; player approach on the axis at y 3850 (40 cm past the wall plane), retreat WEST 700, strafe 300 each side. The dead CEO lies against the east wall 20 cm south of the idle capsule (x 1900-1980, y 3980-4060), inside the same hidden wedge. The window is authored as an opening of type window between ceo_office and 'exterior' (no backdrop room: nothing is built beyond the glass in Gate 1; the Gate 2 backdrop plane goes >= 300 cm behind it). Duct convention: start = centre-line point on the INTERIOR face of the closet's south wall; length_cm = face-to-face distance including both 20 cm walls (430 -> 950 = 520). Positions Rob drew that the spec moved (Demon #1 inside Office #2, Demon #2 in the reception half, dead guard inside the break room's NW corner, vanity in the men's SE corner) are recorded as note markers; the open questions for Rob are in Docs/FLOORPLAN.md.
